searchText: What minimum tip threshold is Besu/Nethermind using? Also, do they mine the tx if the actual effective miner reward is below the threshold? And do they accept transactions with tip > feeCap? <@!680337202521440470> about your spamming method: did you just sequentially sign transactions with increasing nonces from those two accounts and assume that all of them will be includable eventually? Or did you re-send transactions with the same nonce if stuck? Also, did you ever create transactions with tip > feeCap? Another important corner case question for the other clients: do you allow a tx in the pool if it can't pay for its own `feeCap` (`balance < feeCap * gasLimit`) but can pay the current `baseFee + tip`? Geth rejects these, maybe that's another reason it has less pending when the balance starts to run out (I mean if Besu allows them in the pool, of course). Everyone please read the conversation in ACD started by Martin at https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/745077610685661265/847743262672420864 with regards to a DoS vector introduced by EIP-1559. Also please consider the options listed at https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/745077610685661265/847748055335305286 and vote or comment on your feelings (plus ideally read the existing discussion about those options). So with my spamming I synchronize the nonce regularly in order to resend with the same nonce if transactions have not been included . And for the tests at the beginning the tip was below feecap but that changed when we used 10 billion for the tip because the range of the feecap was [10 billion, 50 billion] I tried spamming differently . I do not send transactions directly to the Besu sealer and I spam with two tools in parallel on different accounts that send on two different nodes. This seems to be better and Geth filled the blocks Can I get a review on https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3595 from an author of 1559? It is just some touchup/consistency stuff.
